mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies near Verona City Hall under a waxing crescent moon. Please note the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.
Looking at the latest from the City of Verona, there were no new emails received today, but residents should note the recent police reports regarding traffic safety.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Bogey Factory and The Mill, live music at Paddy Mac's, and pizza night at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead to tomorrow, check out ART House 360 or Hop Haus trivia.

The Verona Police Department recently released their report from October 5 through October 12, noting that on October 9, a two-vehicle crash occurred on USH 18/151 near mile marker 76, resulting in one driver being transported to a hospital.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the delicious Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
